TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Perform a lookup on the Pay Period table matching the values from the parameter value.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: lkp_Existing_Pay_Period

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION:
DECODE(TRUE,
(ISNULL(INIT_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR) OR IS_SPACES(INIT_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR) OR LENGTH(LTRIM(INIT_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR)) = 0) AND
(ISNULL(INIT_PARAM_PP_NUM) OR IS_SPACES(INIT_PARAM_PP_NUM) OR LENGTH(LTRIM(INIT_PARAM_PP_NUM)) = 0), TRUE,
FALSE)
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: v_DEFAULT_TO_CURR_PP_FLAG

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION:
DECODE(TRUE,
v_DEFAULT_TO_CURR_PP_FLAG = TRUE, lkp_CURR_PP_END_YEAR,
v_PAY_PERIOD_PARAM_EXISTS_FLAG = TRUE, PARAM_PP_END_YEAR )
--IIF(v_PAY_PERIOD_PARAM_EXISTS_FLAG = TRUE, -- TO_CHAR(PARAM_PP_END_YEAR), -- TO_CHAR(lkp_CURR_PP_END_YEAR))
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: v_PP_END_YEAR

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION:
DECODE(TRUE,
v_DEFAULT_TO_CURR_PP_FLAG = TRUE, lkp_CURR_PP_NUM,
v_PAY_PERIOD_PARAM_EXISTS_FLAG = TRUE, PARAM_PP_NUM )
--IIF(v_PAY_PERIOD_PARAM_EXISTS_FLAG = TRUE, -- TO_CHAR(PARAM_PP_NUM), -- TO_CHAR(lkp_CURR_PP_NUM))
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: v_PP_NUM

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT MAX(PP_NUM) PP_NUM , MAX(PP_END_YEAR) PP_END_YEAR FROM PAY_PERIOD

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: The parameters PP_NUM and PP_END_YEAR are set to outport ports which will be validated in the following tranformation.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: exp_Initial

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION:
DECODE(TRUE,
NOT IS_NUMBER(INIT_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR) AND DEFAULT_TO_CURR_PP_FLAG = FALSE, TRUE,
NOT IS_NUMBER(INIT_PARAM_PP_NUM) AND DEFAULT_TO_CURR_PP_FLAG = FALSE, TRUE,
ISNULL(lkp_DFAS_PSEUDO_SSN), TRUE,
FALSE)
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: v_ABORT_FLAG

TRANSFORMFIELD.EXPRESSION:
DECODE(TRUE,
v_ABORT_FLAG = TRUE AND NOT IS_NUMBER(INIT_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR) AND DEFAULT_TO_CURR_PP_FLAG = FALSE, ABORT('!!!! The value : ' || INIT_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR || ' is not a valid pay period year'),
v_ABORT_FLAG = TRUE AND NOT IS_NUMBER(INIT_PARAM_PP_NUM) AND DEFAULT_TO_CURR_PP_FLAG = FALSE, ABORT('!!!! The value : ' || INIT_PARAM_PP_NUM || ' is not a valid pay period number'),
v_ABORT_FLAG = TRUE AND ISNULL(lkp_DFAS_PSEUDO_SSN), ABORT('!!!! There were no FEEDER records found for this pay period: ' || PARAM_PP_END_YEAR || '-' || LPAD(PARAM_PP_NUM, 2, '0')),
FALSE)
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: o_ABORT_MESSAGE

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup condition
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: PP_END_YEAR = in_PARAM_PP_END_YEAR AND PP_NUM = in_PARAM_PP_NUM AND MP_POOL_DES = in_MP_POOL_DES
